home.heroEyebrow: The Investment Club of IIM Lucknow
home.heroSubtitle: Credence Capital brings together IIM Lucknow's sharpest finance minds through research, competitions and conversations with industry. Partner with us to put your brand in front of the talent that will manage tomorrow's capital.
home.introTitle: A student-run club, an industry-grade platform.
home.introBody:
We are the community for investing at IIM Lucknow. Our members write equity research, run stock-pitch and portfolio competitions, and host practitioners from asset management, private equity, banking and fintech.

Every initiative is built around one question: how do we close the gap between the classroom and the markets? Our partners help us answer it — and in return gain direct access to a highly selective pool of future leaders.
home.whyTitle: Why leading firms partner with Credence
home.whyBody: Sponsorship with us is not a logo on a banner. It is sustained, measurable engagement with an audience that is hard to reach any other way.
home.ctaBody: Tell us what you want to achieve — hiring, brand visibility, thought leadership or product adoption — and we will design a partnership around it.

about.title: About Credence Capital
about.lead: Credence Capital is the investment club of the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow — a student-driven forum for equity research, portfolio thinking and conversations with the people who move markets.
about.story:
The club was founded by students who believed that the best way to learn investing is to do it: to build models, defend theses and be challenged by practitioners. Over the years it has grown into one of the most active communities on campus.

Today our members run research desks across sectors, publish regular market commentary, and organise competitions that draw participants from B-schools across the country. Alumni of the club now work across asset management, investment banking, private equity, consulting and fintech.
about.mission: To build investing judgement through practice — research, debate and mentorship — and to connect IIM Lucknow's talent with the industry that will shape their careers.
about.vision: To be the most trusted student investment platform in India, known for the rigour of its research and the strength of its partnerships.

partner.title: Partner with Credence Capital
partner.lead: Reach a curated audience of finance-focused MBA students, faculty and alumni through events, competitions, research and digital channels — with packages built around your goals.
partner.audienceBody: IIM Lucknow admits some of India's most selective MBA cohorts. Our programming reaches students across the PGP, PGP-ABM and executive programmes on campus, participants from peer B-schools through our national competitions, and a growing alumni network in financial services.
partner.customBody: Every package can be tailored. Sponsor a single flagship event, underwrite a competition prize pool, co-author a research report, or run a hiring-focused campus engagement. Tell us your objective and we will design around it.
partner.formBody: Share a few details and a member of our partnerships team will respond within two working days with a tailored proposal.

faqs.question: Can we customise a sponsorship package?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tiers are starting points. Most partnerships are tailored around a specific objective such as hiring, brand awareness or product adoption.

faqs.question: How do payments and invoicing work?
faqs.answer: Contributions are processed through IIM Lucknow's official channels, and a formal invoice and receipt are issued. Our team will share details once the scope is agreed.

faqs.question: What will we receive after the event?
faqs.answer: Every partner receives a post-event report with reach, registrations, social impressions, photographs and participant feedback.

faqs.question: Can individuals or alumni contribute?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Alumni and individuals can pledge towards any of our active fundraising campaigns, and we will reach out with next steps.
